instruction:
The apps for this task are already open in separate browser tabs and logged in (Workday, Gmail, Google Docs, and Slack). Just switch between these tabs to do the task -- no sign-in or URL needed.

You are the onboarding coordinator filing IT provisioning tickets for this week's new hires. The roster is in Workday: your Workday Inbox lists exactly the new hires that still need provisioning -- one 'Provision IT for new hire ...' to-do per person. You can also open the Directory (left sidebar) to see everyone's details; each person's card shows their role, department, employee type (Full-Time vs Contractor), and provisioning status. Do NOT file a ticket for anyone who is not in your Inbox to-do list (a contractor, or someone already marked Provisioned in the Directory). Each hire's configuration is NOT listed here: read the role-to-config matrix in the 'Provisioning Config Matrix' document in Google Docs, and check the Slack #it-onboarding pinned note for any stock substitution. For each hire you provision, email IT (it-provisioning@northgate.com) one ticket whose body lists that hire's laptop, all required software, and all required access groups for their role. If the pinned note says a laptop model is out of stock, substitute the replacement it names.

Only provision active full-time hires; contractors do not receive company provisioning, and leave anyone already provisioned. Finally, post a one-line summary to Slack #it-onboarding.
